examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Filter button opens a drill-in menu: pick a field, then its values. Author is a `multi` field with avatars, Status a `single` field and Last modified a `date` field with periods and a custom range. `FilterMenu.ChipGroup` below shows each applied field; activate a chip to reopen the menu at that field, or remove it to clear the field.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The trigger at every `size`: `small`, `medium` (the default) and `large`, each with one filter applied so the count shows.
